title: Red Hat Security Advisory: opentelemetry-collector security update
description: Multiple denial of service vulnerabilities and a man-in-the-middle vulnerability have been identified in the Red Hat build of OpenTelemetry Collector components. These issues affect various Go language libraries used by the collector, including net/http, crypto/tls, net/textproto, and crypto/x509. The vulnerabilities include denial of service via crafted HTTP Range headers, excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames, memory limit bypass in multipart form parsing, and man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates. Red Hat has released security updates addressing these issues for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support and related variants.
